entity_raw.definition_raw:
You are an expert at keeping creatures on the ground.

Prerequisite(s): Combat Expertise, Kobold Groundling, Kobold Style, Small size or smaller.

Benefit(s): You can make a grapple combat maneuver check to mount a prone Medium or Large foe. If you’re successful, you move into the target’s square and are considered to be on top of the target. For the target to stand, it must succeed at a combat maneuver check to break your grapple.
